Title: salesRepActivities - Served Organization Returns Only That Organization's Events With Platform Rows Present
Section: GraphQL > Sales Rep > Query > salesRepActivities > Scope
Preconditions: Runner-native via [GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]. Requires SalesRep 3.1015+ with GoogleEcommerceAnalytics installed. Caller is a PLAIN rep (SALES_REP = SR_REP_PRIMARY; administrators pass every scope check). storeId is passed explicitly. @td(ORG_ACME.platform_id) is served by SR_REP_PRIMARY and holds platform rows (a membership-dated customers row) regardless of GA lag, so the case is non-vacuous even when no GA data has arrived. {SPEC} (VCST-5731 AC-6: only the served organization's events).
Steps:
[GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]
[AUTH role=SALES_REP]
[GQL-OP main]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}", take: 50) { totalCount isAnalyticsAvailable categoryCounts { category count } items { category type occurredAt precision count organizationId organizationName orderId orderNumber orderTotal { amount } searchTerm productId productCode productName } } }
[GQL-EXEC main]
Assertions:
[ERRORS label=main] errors[] empty {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02)
[DATA label=main] data.salesRepActivities.totalCount >= 1 {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02: Customers category is platform data)
[COUNT label=main] data.salesRepActivities.items[*?organizationId!={{org}}].length = 0 {SPEC} (VCST-5731 AC-6)
[DATA label=main] data.salesRepActivities.items.0.occurredAt is non-null {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02)
[DATA label=main] data.salesRepActivities.isAnalyticsAvailable is non-null {SPEC}
Failure_Signals:
an item whose organizationId differs from the requested served org
errors[] non-empty
totalCount 0 although the org has platform rows
References: VCST-5337, VCST-5731 · Archetype:SCOPE · Technique:EP · Purpose:FUNC · Catches:VCST-5337

The tab-count invariant of the activity page: counts do not change with the selected tab, because the page's tab selection is the categories filter. {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02 D-7). Behaviour of an unknown category and the row-vs-event split is {OBSERVED} (KB-B7076554, single observation on SalesRep 3.1013/3.1015) and is asserted only where the spec also states it.

[GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]
[AUTH role=SALES_REP]
[GQL-OP unfiltered]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}") { totalCount categoryCounts { category count } } }
[GQL-EXEC unfiltered]
[GQL-CAPTURE unfiltered.data.salesRepActivities.categoryCounts.0.category → CAT0]
[GQL-CAPTURE unfiltered.data.salesRepActivities.categoryCounts.0.count → CAT0_COUNT]
[GQL-OP filtered]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}", categories: ["{{CAT0}}"]) { totalCount categoryCounts { category count } items { category } } }
[GQL-EXEC filtered]
[GQL-OP unknown]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}", categories: ["no-such-category"]) { totalCount items { category } } }
[GQL-EXEC unknown]
Assertions:
[ERRORS label=unfiltered] errors[] empty {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02)
[DATA label=unfiltered] data.salesRepActivities.categoryCounts.length >= 5 {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02: six tabs incl. All is UI-side; five categories server-side)
[ERRORS label=filtered] errors[] empty {SPEC}
[COUNT label=filtered] data.salesRepActivities.items[*?category!={{CAT0}}].length = 0 {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02)
[DATA label=filtered] data.salesRepActivities.categoryCounts[?category={{CAT0}}].count = {{CAT0_COUNT}} {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02 D-7: a tab's count is the same whichever tab is selected)
[ERRORS label=unknown] errors[] empty {OBSERVED} (KB-B7076554)
[DATA label=unknown] data.salesRepActivities.totalCount = 0 {OBSERVED} (KB-B7076554)
Failure_Signals:
categoryCounts change with the filter (badge flips when another tab is selected)
an unknown category raises errors[] or returns rows
References: VCST-5337, VCST-5731 · Archetype:PARITY · Technique:EP · Purpose:FUNC · Catches:VCST-5337

Title: salesRepActivities - A Shorter Period Never Holds More Than a Longer One, and a 2000-2010 Window Holds Nothing
Section: GraphQL > Sales Rep > Query > salesRepActivities > Period
Preconditions: Runner-native via [GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]. Requires SalesRep 3.1015+ with GoogleEcommerceAnalytics installed. Caller is a PLAIN rep (SALES_REP = SR_REP_PRIMARY; administrators pass every scope check). storeId is passed explicitly. Nested fixed windows (never derived from today, as in 050m): ancient 2000-01-01..2010-12-31 inside wide 2000-01-01..2099-12-31 inside the omitted period (all time). BL-SR-001: bounds are inclusive UTC instants, omitted bounds mean all time. {SPEC} (VCST-5337 checklist D-9/16/17: This month <= This year <= All time). Compares totalCount (rows) with itself across windows, never rows with events.
Steps:
[GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]
[AUTH role=SALES_REP]
[GQL-OP alltime]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}") { totalCount } }
[GQL-EXEC alltime]
[GQL-CAPTURE alltime.data.salesRepActivities.totalCount → ALL_N]
[GQL-OP wide]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}", period: {from: "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z", to: "2099-12-31T23:59:59Z"}) { totalCount } }
[GQL-EXEC wide]
[GQL-CAPTURE wide.data.salesRepActivities.totalCount → WIDE_N]
[GQL-OP ancient]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}", period: {from: "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z", to: "2010-12-31T23:59:59Z"}) { totalCount items { category } } }
[GQL-EXEC ancient]
Failure_Signals:
the 2000-2010 window returns rows (period ignored)
errors[] on a bounded period
References: VCST-5337, VCST-5731 · Archetype:BOUNDARY · Technique:BVA · Purpose:FUNC · Catches:VCST-5337

Title: salesRepActivities - take Clamps at 50, Negative take Returns Nothing, and Rows Past the 500-Row Window Return Nothing With Counts Unchanged
Section: GraphQL > Sales Rep > Query > salesRepActivities > Paging
Preconditions: Runner-native via [GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]. Requires SalesRep 3.1015+ with GoogleEcommerceAnalytics installed. Caller is a PLAIN rep (SALES_REP = SR_REP_PRIMARY; administrators pass every scope check). storeId is passed explicitly. {OBSERVED} (KB-B7076554, SalesRep 3.1013/3.1015, single observation): take 51 and 1000 return 50 items, negative take returns 0 items, skip 500/501/520 return 0 items while totalCount and categoryCounts stay unchanged, negative skip is treated as 0. {SPEC} for the window: 20 rows per page, up to 26 pages (VCST-5337 2026-10-02). Since the observation is not a spec of the clamp value, a mismatch is re-observed, not auto-failed as a regression of intent; the 'rows past the window do not repeat' check is the spec-bearing assertion.
Steps:
[GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]
[AUTH role=SALES_REP]
[GQL-OP clampq]
query { salesRepActivities(storeId: "{{store}}", take: 1000) { totalCount items { category } } }
[GQL-EXEC clampq]
[GQL-OP negtake]
query { salesRepActivities(storeId: "{{store}}", take: -1) { items { category } } }
[GQL-EXEC negtake]
[GQL-OP head]
query { salesRepActivities(storeId: "{{store}}", take: 5, skip: 0) { totalCount categoryCounts { category count } items { occurredAt category } } }
[GQL-EXEC head]
[GQL-CAPTURE head.data.salesRepActivities.totalCount → HEAD_N]
[GQL-OP past]
query { salesRepActivities(storeId: "{{store}}", take: 5, skip: 501) { totalCount categoryCounts { category count } items { occurredAt category } } }
[GQL-EXEC past]
Failure_Signals:
skip 501 repeats rows from the start of the window
negative take or oversized take raises errors[]
References: VCST-5337, VCST-5731 · Archetype:BOUNDARY · Technique:BVA · Purpose:FUNC · Catches:VCST-5337

Title: salesRepCustomerActivitySummary - Total Visits Equals the Logins Event Count and Platform Fields Are Present
Section: GraphQL > Sales Rep > Query > salesRepCustomerActivitySummary > Consistency
Preconditions: Runner-native via [GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]. Requires SalesRep 3.1015+ with GoogleEcommerceAnalytics installed. Caller is a PLAIN rep (SALES_REP = SR_REP_PRIMARY; administrators pass every scope check). storeId is passed explicitly. {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-13: 'the Logins tab agrees with Total visits'). [AUTH role=SALES_REP]
[GQL-OP summary]

[GQL-CAPTURE summary.data.salesRepCustomerActivitySummary.visitsCount → VISITS_N]
[GQL-OP acts]
query { salesRepActivities(organizationId: "{{org}}", storeId: "{{store}}") { isAnalyticsAvailable categoryCounts { category count } } }
[GQL-EXEC acts]
Failure_Signals:
visitsCount differs from the logins category count (row vs event counting)
createdOn null
